name: experimental_threat_reinterpretation_pair
status: exploratory; coherent on some prompts, sometimes invents danger
hook: post-SwiGLU MLP coordinate offset on every input of a generation
formula: activation_delta = signed_relative_dose * median(prompt residual norm leaving layer) / norm(quantized down_proj column)
limitations: The second neuron alone also encourages suspicious readings on some inputs. The pair is a causal steering handle, not evidence of a nonlinear circuit or accurate danger detection.
